units.source_text: 驹子用手指拨断了第三根弦，换上新弦后把音试调好了。

en.t: Komako snapped the third string with her finger, then put on a new one and tuned it.

units.source_text: 此时，岛村已听出它的音色十分清越。

en.t: By then, Shimamura could already hear how clear and bright its tone was.

units.source_text: 但打开放在被炉上鼓鼓囊囊的包袱一看，

en.t: But when he opened the bulging bundle lying on the kotatsu,

units.source_text: 里面除了普通的旧乐谱以外，

en.t: inside, besides the ordinary old sheet music,

units.source_text: 还有二十来册杵家弥七［杵家弥七（１８９０—１９４２），长歌三弦专家］的《文化三弦谱》。

en.t: there were also some twenty volumes of Kineya Yashichi's Cultural Shamisen Scores, Kineya Yashichi, 1890 to 1942, a specialist in nagauta shamisen.

units.source_text: 岛村感到意外，拿在手里说：

en.t: Shimamura was surprised, and taking it in his hand, said:
